newsitem.title: UK: NWE OIL PRODUCTS FALL LED BY $7 DROP IN MOGAS.
newsitem.headline: NWE OIL PRODUCTS FALL LED BY $7 DROP IN MOGAS.

text.p: NWE oil products slipped lower on Thursday morning, led by weak gasoline which lost $7 a tonne soon after the open.
Rotterdam premium unleaded gasoline traded at $232 and $230 with August swaps offered at $216 compared to trade above $220 on Wednesday.
"It looks a little under pressure this morning. We're still looking for bids on August," said a broker.
Gas oil dropped $2 a tonne in line with IPE futures but premiums for barges and cargoes were steady.
Heavy fuel was also looking weak. High sulphur barges traded at $94 fob a couple of times, the low end of Wednesday's range and August swaps talked at the same level.
